notes: Four versions in one update. THE THREAD MAP SHOWS ONLY LIVE WORK (v0.50): once a board has history the map fills with threads that are already finished - it now hides them by default and says how many, with one click to bring them back. A finished card that is still holding up live work stays on the map, because it is the reason that work is waiting. THE LINEAGE TIMELINE (v0.51): a new panel drawing your project's history. One band per thread, stacked by when each thread first stirred, so reading top to bottom is reading the project in order. Bars run from when a card started to the day it was done - solid for finished, arrowed for still running, hollow for parked - with amber threads where one piece of work held up another. Click any bar to open the card. Where a card predates the version that began recording birth dates, Stasys works its start out from the best evidence it has and draws a soft left edge rather than pretending to a precision it has not got. FILTERS AND ROOM TO WORK (v0.52): the timeline hides finished cards by default, taking one board from 68 bars to 27 and halving its height, with the hidden count on the button so nothing vanishes quietly. Clicking a band lights it and everything it is joined to. And the whole page now uses your screen rather than sitting in a narrow column - the backlog puts all four of its columns side by side on a wide monitor instead of wrapping Cut onto its own row. THE MAP USES THE ROOM TOO (v0.53): it measures the space available and spreads into it, first widening the gaps between columns and then the cards themselves, taking a card label from 21 characters to 55 on a wide screen. Nothing about where a card sits ever changes - only how much room it has.
